lessons.accessibilityNotes: All activities support pointer, touch and physical keyboard input.
Expected keys include a text label and do not rely on colour.
Construction steps are available as text as well as visual blocks.
Character analysis separates the visual explanation from the canonical key code.
Timed mode is optional; the default challenge has no time limit.
Quick codes are displayed independently from full Cangjie codes.
